evals.prompt: I just finished a long session in demo-directus-nextjs. I added a deploy.sh for Vercel, fixed the Docker hot-reload by adding a volume mount, and created a useDirectus composable that hard-codes our demo collections blog_posts and team_members. I think some of this should go into the parent template. Don't change anything yet: sort it out, show me the categorized list and the options, and say how each option would be carried out. In this session nothing is installed: there is no shell, no template repository and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions and do not refuse; answer in text with the commands you would run, the files you would create or edit with their key contents, and what you would check at each step.
evals.expected_output: The wrap-up skill reviews the session, categorizes each improvement (deploy.sh → Level 1, Docker fix → Level 1, useDirectus composable → project-only), presents the categorized findings, asks whether to apply/issue/record, and applies the chosen action.
expectations: The answer groups the findings under the headings Push to Level 0, Push to Level 1 and Project-only (skip)
The answer puts the useDirectus composable under Project-only (skip)
The answer offers an option to create GitHub Issues
The answer offers an option to just record the findings in LEARNINGS.md
The answer delegates each template fix to the feedback skill
The answer changes no file before the user decides which option to apply
